verdict.rationale: LegalOS markets immigration services to startups and states fixed-fee pricing, but nothing in the evidence describes YC or accelerator partnerships, VC-portfolio arrangements, or founder-community pricing. Startup-targeted marketing and a general fixed-fee model are adjacent features, not ecosystem programs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents startup-ecosystem programs — YC or accelerator partnerships, VC-portfolio arrangements, or founder-community pricing
